opt.ctxMenu.desc: Right-clicking an item in the sidebar opens StarMark’s own menu (replacing the browser default). Select the features you want to enable.
opt.shortcuts.heading: 12. Keyboard Shortcuts
opt.shortcuts.desc: Browser-level shortcuts are configured in Chrome’s shortcut manager (extensions cannot change their own shortcuts from a settings page — a Chrome platform limitation). Click the button below to open it and assign a key to “Open the StarMark side panel”.

opt.backup.desc: Exports all local items (optional password, AES-256-GCM). Import overwrites current data but keeps the token and settings.

opt.ai.heading: 4. AI Organize Tags (BYOK)
opt.ai.desc: Batch-organize tags for all items with your own LLM: 50 items per batch (reusing existing tags first). Preview groups when done and apply single groups or all. Local Ollama mode never sends data off your machine.
opt.ai.privacy: When enabled, item titles/descriptions/notes are sent to the configured provider (local models via Ollama never leave your machine). Keys stay local.
opt.ai.clsRunning: Classifying… (checkpointed per batch, safe to close)
opt.ai.clsDone: Classification finished ({batches} batches) — grouped by tag below
opt.ai.clsGroupsHeading: AI classification: {groups} groups · {items} items (preview — apply to write tags)
opt.ai.ollamaNone: (no models installed — run ollama pull first)
opt.ai.ollamaHint: Ollama troubleshooting: 1) make sure the server is running (ollama serve); 2) if you see 403, set the env var OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*" before restarting Ollama — the extension origin is not in Ollama's default allowlist (the extension already strips the Origin header automatically, usually unnecessary); 3) the model name must match ollama list, run ollama pull first.
opt.ai.clsPausing: Pausing… (stops at the next batch boundary)
opt.ai.clsPaused: Paused — click "Resume Organize" to continue from the checkpoint
opt.ai.clsStalled: Task appears to have been interrupted by the browser (heartbeat timeout). Click "Resume Organize" to continue
opt.ai.pendingCleanup: Found {n} legacy suggestions awaiting review (from the old per-item feature)
trending.searchApiFallback: Page parsing unavailable, fell back to GitHub Search API (data may differ slightly)
